## Scope

What the subject is, in two sentences, and what this spec deliberately does
not cover.

## Behaviour-goal statements

Numbered `S-nnn-k`. Form: subject, verb, observable behaviour, quantity with
unit, evidence tag, source pointer.

- S-nnn-1. <subject> shall/does … `[S]` (<source>)
- S-nnn-2. …

## Interfaces we depend on

Connectors, APIs, file formats, units, sign conventions.

## Known unknowns

Statements we could not make from primary sources, each with the gate that
will resolve it.
